__purpose: Player node: convert an incoming video ref into playMedia/stopMedia commands for routing to Client/Display sinks.
label: Video Player

metadata.description: Converts a video ref into playMedia/stopMedia commands for Client or Display sinks.

compatibility.rule: Connect cmd output to Display to route video playback commands to selected Display endpoints.
compatibility.repairHint: If the video is not visible on Display, confirm the Display node is connected and routed to the correct targets.

compatibility.rule: Connect cmd output to Client Executor to route video playback commands to audience clients.

repairHints: An empty video input emits stopMedia.
